$about: The one source for LOG's design values. `npm run tokens` (also run before every build) writes src/styles/tokens.gen.css, src/tokens/tokens.js and the colors block of DESIGN.md. Edit values here, never in the generated files. Keys are the CSS custom property names without the leading --.

night.note: asphalt at night: the brand dark. The map, the control company, the footer, headlines on paper

night-deep.note: behind the page: under the map and the book

night-rule-soft.note: rule-soft inside night worlds (the token swap in pages.css)

paper.note: road paper: the day ground of reading pages

rule.note: a line on paper: fields, tables, numbering

rule-soft.note: a soft line: separators inside a list

works.note: LOG orange, from the brand book: the one thing that matters now. Never text on paper (2.0:1); night on it 7.7:1

works-light.note: a second tag, bars in a chart. Never text on paper

works-deep.note: orange that has to read as small text on paper (4.7:1)

sign-ink.note: text on orange: always dark, never white

logo-grey.note: the grey half of the logo, read from the v3 book's logo image until LOG sends the master

logo-orange-deep.note: the dark end of the logo's orange gradient; the light end is --works

map-sky.note: the lit edge of the night sky: the 3D map's sky, the drawings' sky, the gantry's steel edge

map-sky-zenith.note: the far end of the night sky

map-tree.note: trees in the drawings: the one green, muted into the night

map-tree-lit.note: the lit side of a tree

font-display.note: subheads, labels, buttons: Assistant ExtraBold, Bold and SemiBold

font-headline.note: headlines: Rubik Black, two to four words, closed by a period

font-figure.note: big numbers and numbering: Assistant Light

fs-h1.note: 40 → 64: page titles, the home headline, the big figures. Rubik Black is wide and heavy: 64 carries what 72 did in a narrow face

fs-h3.note: 32 → 40: destination rows, lead cards, step titles

fs-h4.note: 24 → 28: card titles, steps, quotes. 28 is the book's subhead

fs-base.note: 19: body, buttons, legends. Assistant sets small for its size: 19 reads as 18 did

fs-micro.note: 15: map labels, table heads. Nothing is set smaller

fw-medium.note: labels and buttons: Assistant SemiBold (its 500 reads as regular)

track-headline.note: Rubik Black headlines: Rubik is spaced for text, a hair closer at display sizes

r-control.note: the one radius: buttons, fields, chips and tags. The book allows a rounded corner only in a thin line, so no pills; photographs and surfaces stay square

r-frame.note: the frame around the home map while it opens

frame.note: the home map's inset from the window

line-w.note: every line and circle in the language, one weight: thin, so it reads as drawn, not built

rule-w.note: the grey hair between the rows of a list or a table, as the book draws it. Never in ink, never a frame

dot.note: the dot at a line's end or crossing: filled, no ring

dash.note: a dashed line: what doesn't exist yet

switch-blend.note: the short gradient where a switch line turns from grey to orange
